Container.Name: MediaOps Discord Router
Container.Overview: Optional hardened companion service for MediaOps that receives Ombi or Seerr webhook notifications and routes media-request lifecycle updates into managed Discord Forum threads. Historical image/path identifiers are retained for upgrade compatibility.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: mediaops discord router ombi seerr discord forum request webhook media server homelab
Container.Requires: Requires Ombi or Seerr, a Discord Forum webhook, configured Forum tag IDs, and private network reachability. Seerr can additionally use the shared-secret webhook header. Never expose router port 8080 directly to the Internet.

Config.Name: Router Data
Config.Description: Persistent MediaOps Discord Router request/thread index.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone used by the router.

Config.Name: Media Requests Webhook
Config.Description: Full Discord Forum webhook URL. Secret: never publish or log it.

Config.Name: Webhook Display Name
Config.Description: Display name used by the Discord webhook.

Config.Name: Discord Bot Token
Config.Description: Optional token for dynamic Forum tag updates. Keep masked and least-privileged.

Config.Name: Requested Status Tag ID
Config.Description: Forum tag ID for Requested.

Config.Name: Processing Status Tag ID
Config.Description: Forum tag ID for Processing.

Config.Name: Available Status Tag ID
Config.Description: Forum tag ID for Available.

Config.Name: Failed Status Tag ID
Config.Description: Forum tag ID for Failed.

Config.Name: Denied Status Tag ID
Config.Description: Forum tag ID for Denied.

Config.Name: Movie Media Tag ID
Config.Description: Forum Movie tag ID.

Config.Name: Series Media Tag ID
Config.Description: Forum Series tag ID.

Config.Name: Test Tag ID
Config.Description: Optional provider webhook diagnostic tag.

Config.Name: Webhook Auth Header
Config.Description: HTTP header used for provider shared-secret authentication. Do not place secrets in URLs.

Config.Name: Max Webhook Body Bytes
Config.Description: Maximum accepted provider request body size (256 KiB default).

Config.Name: Seerr Webhook Auth
Config.Description: off, optional, or required. Configure the matching custom header in Seerr before selecting required.

Config.Name: Seerr Webhook Token
Config.Description: Shared secret expected from Seerr in the configured auth header. Generate a long random value and keep it masked.

Config.Name: Ombi Webhook Auth
Config.Description: off, optional, or required. Keep off unless Ombi traffic passes through a trusted component that adds the configured header; keep Ombi/router on a private Docker network.

Config.Name: Ombi Webhook Token
Config.Description: Optional shared secret for authenticated Ombi ingress through a trusted proxy/integration. Never put it in a webhook query string.

Config.Name: Router Data Directory
Config.Description: Container path for persistent request/thread index.
